### Package Installation

```{r include=FALSE}
install.packages("tidyverse") # Tidyverse packages contain tools for data manipulation, cleaning, string parsing and visualization
library(tidyverse) 
```

### Reading all csv files

```{r}
library(data.table) # for reading csvs  
species <- fread("data/899_Species.csv") 
synonyms <- read_csv("data/synonyms.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
traits <- read_csv("data/traits.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
observation <- fread("data/observation.csv")
survey_header <- read_csv("data/header.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
location <- read_csv("data/location.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

### Describe raw data


### Perform any data manipulation here:

#### Renaming columns

```{r}
library(data.table) 
## Observation
observation <- fread("data/observation.csv")
setnames(observation, old = c("sd_ID", "sd_SpeciesORIG","sd_quality", "sd_Breeding"), new = c("survey_id","species_id", "survey_quality", "breeding_status"))   
colnames(observation) 
```
